# Mystic Rubs

> > Digital marketing, technology tutorials, and online income strategies with a focus on Nepal market

Mystic Rubs provides practical guides on Facebook Pixel, Google Ads, Instagram marketing, and social media advertising, alongside tutorials on WordPress SEO, AI tools, and Web3 technologies. The site emphasizes digital marketing strategies tailored for the Nepal market and offers resources for online income generation.
